transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Thank you. Well, I’m here because I just feel worn down almost all the time. Even after a full night’s sleep, it doesn't really seem to make a difference. By the time I’ve handled work and dealt with the clutter around the house, I just have very little energy left for anything else.
Alongside this low energy, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed?

Yeah, I have. Most days there’s just this... low, gray mood running in the background. I mean, I can still go to the lab and talk to people just fine, but I don’t really feel light or excited about things anymore. Even stuff I usually enjoy, like baking or getting out the telescope, I just don't have that same feeling about them the way I used to.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
It's been quite a while. I'd say this low baseline has been going on since shortly after we moved into our current place. It's an older house, and we moved in a little over two years ago now.
During these past two years, have there been any periods lasting more than two months where your mood returned to normal?

No, not really. I mean, I'll have a good day here and there, or maybe a week where things feel a little lighter. But... no, I don't think I've had a stretch of two whole months where I felt completely back to normal. That low feeling has pretty much just stayed with me the whole time.
How has your self-esteem or confidence in yourself been over this time?
I don't think I've really noticed a big change there. I mean, I still feel competent at my job and everything. I wouldn't say I feel bad about myself, just... tired and flat, mostly.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or eating habits during this time?

No, not really. My appetite has been pretty steady. I still eat my regular meals and... yeah, I haven't noticed any weight changes or anything like that. So I'd say my eating habits are about the same as they've always been.
Have you had any trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or finding yourself sleeping much more than usual?

No, my sleep has been pretty normal, actually. I usually fall asleep without much trouble, and I sleep through the night for the most part. I haven't noticed myself sleeping any more than I usually do, either. Just my regular schedule.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future during this time?

Yeah, a little bit. I just... I catch myself assuming that the house will never really be settled, and that I'm probably just going to keep operating at this reduced level. It makes it really hard to look ahead. Like, I find it hard to plan any trips or even my future stargazing projects, because I just feel like things are going to stay exactly like this.
